en: Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad square bordered by late‑19th‑century multi‑story buildings and leafless trees. A tram and several pedestrians are visible, along with market stalls on the right. At the top, printed red text reads "Budapest. Széna-tér." A building on the right has signage with the partial word "GYOGYSZ…", indicative of a pharmacy in Hungarian.
